records.quote: To address these drawbacks, we present a self-powered thermogalvanic-hydrogel virtual interface for versatile onhand interactions, which is composed of polyvinyl alcohol/trehalose networks absorbed with glycerol/water and exhibits high stretchability, strong adhesion, and rapid self-healing, inspired by algae's stress adaption.

records.subject: Thermoelectricity in response to body heat
records.object: Self-powered transduction of dynamic gestures into electrical signals
records.quote: Leveraging the synergistic coupling of thermoelectricity and active piezoresistivity, the interface achieves selfpowered transduction of dynamic gestures into detectable electrical signals via its intrinsic response to body heat and real-time piezoresistive modulation under mechanical strain.
